_doc: Whole-tree checks ./publish runs before it pushes, and refuses on a red, naming the check and its fix. Owner by card 2026-11-12 ~8:25 PM PST (ledger 2026-11-13T04:34:04Z): Whole-tree checks -> 'Publish runs the fast ones and refuses on red'; validation_map_and_rules.md rule 10. They run in parallel; the list's total stays under budget_s of added wall time. seconds = one run alone on archmagi 2026-11-12 (measured). A check too slow for this list stays in the nightly sweep and is named under nightly_only. A publish whose local commits touch only skip_when_only paths runs nothing. A one-off bypass: RM_PUBLISH_SKIP_TREE_CHECKS='<why>' (printed, never silent). Code: publish.py tree_checks().

name the data root through rmpaths, never D:\Luke\dev\_<dir>
a new root namespace of ours goes in launch_gate.OWN_NAMESPACES; an engine fake lives under tests/, Scenario/ or a selftest folder
never hand-edit FaunaNorm_* patches: change fauna_normalization.py and regenerate its outputs
reorder infrastructure/state/modlists/ModsConfig.FULL.LATEST.xml so every About loadAfter/loadBefore edge holds
write RUT_Umbra, or list a record file in HISTORIC with its reason
a baseline row that now passes leaves drawn_art_ruled_baseline.json; a new unruled drawing gets its ruling
a retired module leaves with its last reference; a moved doc is repointed in entrypoint_inventory.PROBES/KEPT
pass timeout= to the subprocess call the lint names
